info.title: Webmania API2 fiscal report files — draft
info.description: Download of fiscal reports exported by the current report service. fiscalCreateOrPollReport returns a url on this origin for these reports; reports of the legacy store keep using fiscalDownloadReport. Explicit access choices are server alternatives, not SDK fallback behavior.

get.description: Downloads a completed report. While the export is processing, after a failed export or when the stored file expired, the response is HTTP 200 JSON with an error property instead of a file. A report UUID that does not exist, or is not a UUID, is not found.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Report UUID taken from the url returned by fiscalCreateOrPollReport. Never guess or enumerate report identifiers.

200.description: File of a completed report, or a JSON error object at HTTP 200. Select the representation by the actual Content-Type and validate the format from the bytes before accepting a file.

schema.description: HTML rendering exported as the report file itself; never execute it.
Report file whose stored type is not one of the formats above; validate the bytes before use.

401.description: Access refused: credentials were supplied but are incomplete, invalid, inactive or belong to another company, or access without credentials is disabled.

404.description: Unknown report or an identifier that is not a UUID.

429.description: Too many download requests from this client; wait before a deliberate new attempt.

default.description: HTTP or availability failure; never treat HTML or JSON as the requested report file.

x-retry-policy.reason: A download is rate limited and records access. Repeat only as a deliberate new request.

get.x-sdk-authentication-policy: Choose one explicit access mode before requesting: no credentials (the report URL is a sensitive capability), the four company API1 headers together, or the company API2 Bearer. Never retry with another scheme after a refusal and never send credentials to an origin other than https://api.webmania.com.br.

x-auth-origin-policy.redirects: Never follow with credentials. Reauthorize a new origin explicitly.
x-auth-origin-policy.capability: The complete report URL authorizes one exported report and is sensitive. Do not log it or attach credentials to a URL outside the approved origin and path prefix.

get.x-sdk-transfer-policy: Preserve status, media type and raw bytes. Accept a file only after its bytes match the declared format (ZIP local-file signature for ZIP and XLSX, a PDF header for PDF, text for CSV, HTML and XML). A JSON body with an error property is a failure even at HTTP 200.

ReportCompanyBearer.description: Existing company-scoped API2 Bearer of the company that exported the report. A Monitor account token or API1 reseller credentials are not substitutes.

ReportUuid.description: Report UUID in its canonical 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal form.

ReportError.description: Functional or access error. A present error property is always a failure, including HTTP 200.

ReportHttpError.description: HTTP-level error body (not found, throttled or unavailable). Its fields are not guaranteed; treat any such body as a failure.
